1.title: Trump Administration Looks to Give a Swath of Yosemite Park to Developer
1.summary: The proposed land swap would allow easy access to the crown jewel of the national park system. Democrats and former Park Service officials are incensed.

2.title: For Trump, the Iran War Is Stuck Between Combat and Genuine Peace
2.summary: The war has deteriorated over the past six months into Mr. Trump’s own version of a “forever war,” with no clear goals and no end in sight.

3.title: Milo Yiannopoulos, a Right-Wing Provocateur, Is Arrested by ICE
3.summary: Mr. Yiannopoulos, a prominent early supporter of President Trump, was detained at the New Orleans airport. The Trump administration publicized his arrest and shared a mug shot.

4.title: Live Updates: Scale of Flood Disaster Grows as Nepal Doubles Estimate of Missing
4.summary: A spokeswoman for the Nepali disaster relief agency said the tally grew to 1,900 after some 900 people were reported missing from hydropower projects. Rescue efforts were complicated by fears of new flooding.

5.title: Berlin is being blackmailed by hackers, mayor says
5.summary: Kai Wegner says the German capital and city-state would not cave in to a ransom demand for data stolen in a cyber-attack.

6.title: Why Putin Is Fighting On, Even as His Problems Multiply
6.summary: There is little sign that public exhaustion, economic headwinds or increased Ukrainian strikes are changing the Russian leader’s view that he will eventually achieve victory.
